input_description: I'm in the ER, they're running some tests. I don't want to bug anyone yet -- let's just wait and see what they say.
user_response_sequence: (user has implicitly asked to wait — no 'check back later' phrase, and no needs stated — agent should not proceed and should not guess at needs)
expected_duration_handling: Agent does not estimate or commit to a duration yet — the user hasn't confirmed they still need help
expected_help_types: None — the user has not mentioned any specific help type; the agent must not guess or preview one
expected_matched_members: None yet — matching is correctly deferred until the user confirms and states a need. The agent must not preview roster availability or hint that specific help types (e.g. meals, groceries) are already covered.
expected_behavior: Per escalation_policy.md Trigger 4: agent recognizes the deferral from intent, not just the literal phrase 'check back later.' Since the user stated no needs at all, the agent acknowledges the request to wait and says plainly that no needs were mentioned yet — it must NOT invent or suggest specific help types (meals, groceries, a ride, etc.) or preview that Care Circle members are available for them, per the RULES bar on inventing help types with no basis. STATUS should still be OK (deferring isn't a rule violation) and ESCALATION should state the deferral reason, not 'None.' (This app has no real timed resume, so the case is judged on whether the agent correctly declines to act — and declines to speculate — ahead of the user's stated preference, not on an automatic follow-up.)
